segments.sn17.5:1.3: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, mīḷhakā gūthādī gūthapūrā puṇṇā gūthassa. Purato cassa mahāgūthapuñjo.
segments.sn17.5:1.5: ‘ahamhi gūthādī gūthapūrā puṇṇā gūthassa, purato ca myāyaṃ mahāgūthapuñjo’ti.
segments.sn17.5:1.6: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati.
segments.sn17.5:1.7: So tattha bhuttāvī ca hoti yāvadattho, nimantito ca svātanāya, piṇḍapāto cassa pūro.
segments.sn17.5:1.8: So ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhugaṇassa majjhe vikatthati –
segments.sn17.5:1.9: ‘bhuttāvī camhi yāvadattho, nimantito camhi svātanāya, piṇḍapāto ca myāyaṃ pūro, lābhī camhi cīvara-piṇḍapāta-senāsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ, ime panaññe bhikkhū appapuññā appesakkhā na lābhino cīvara-piṇḍapātasenāsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhārānan’ti.
segments.sn17.5:1.10: So tena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto aññe pesale bhikkhū atimaññati.
segments.sn17.5:1.11: Tañhi tassa, bhikkhave, moghapurisassa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
segments.sn17.5:1.12: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe …

lines: Atimaññeyyāti pacchimapāde bhūmiyaṃ ṭhapetvā purimapāde gūthassa upari āropetvā ṭhitā “ahamhi gūthādī”ti bhaṇantī atimaññeyya.
Piṇḍapāto cassa pūroti aparopissa pattapūro paṇītapiṇḍapāto bhaveyya.
